test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

That night the dinner was special, and the _________ himself came out to read out the menu list.
solution:
The correct answer is "**chef."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the sentence hints at a special occasion related to dining, where menu knowledge is paramount.
 
• The "chef" is the most contextually appropriate choice, as chefs are directly related to the preparation and presentation of meals.
 
• Using "himself" emphasizes the importance or uniqueness of the chef's appearance.
 
• This option fits naturally into the narrative of a dining establishment presenting a special menu or experience.

**Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 4". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1) servant, while related to service, does not directly tie into the reading of a menu list in this context.
 
• Option 2) public and Option 3) guest are not roles that would read out a menu list, making them irrelevant choices.
